description: This file contains unit tests for the BasketService class, specifically testing the SetQuantities method. It verifies behavior such as handling missing baskets and updating/removing items within a basket.

classes.name: SetQuantitiesTests
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for the BasketService.SetQuantities method, testing basket retrieval, item updating, and item removal behavior.

methods.name: ReturnsNotFoundWhenBasketMissing
methods.description: Tests that SetQuantities returns a NotFound result when the basket does not exist.

methods.name: UpdatesExistingItemQuantitiesAndRemovesZeros
methods.description: Tests that SetQuantities updates item quantities correctly and removes items with zero quantity.
